project_name.justification: The article discusses an option agreement for the Renard project: "Winsome to extend its Exclusive Option to Acquire the Renard Project to 31 December 2024..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Winsome Resources (ASX: WR1) (Winsome or the Company)".

ceo_buyer.justification: A quote in the article is attributed to "Chris Evans, Managing Director."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The announcement is about an extension of an option to acquire the project, not a completed acquisition of a specific interest. The option is to acquire "the assets comprising the Renard diamond mine... or all of the issued capital in Stornoway Diamonds (Canada) Inc.", but no interest has been acquired yet.

primary_commodity.justification: The asset is described as the "Renard diamond mine". The text states Winsome secured an option to acquire "the assets comprising the Renard diamond mine, processing facility and associated infrastructure (Renard Operation or Renard)".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled "WINSOME RENARD PROJECT UPDATE" and details the extension of an option for Winsome Resources to acquire the Renard Project, which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The payment for the option extension is specified in Canadian dollars: "...by paying a further C$2 million in cash in accordance with the Option."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The cost to extend the option is C$2 million in cash: "Winsome has elected to pre-emptively extend the Option period by 3 months from 30 September 2024 to 31 December 2024, by paying a further C$2 million in cash in accordance with the Option."

share_payments_raw.justification: The payment for the option extension is specified as cash only.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The payment is explicitly detailed as a cash payment, not a combined cash and share payment.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of this option extension agreement.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any share warrant payments as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text does not mention any stock option payments as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The text does not mention any exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text does not mention any financial commitment for exploration. The payment made is for the option extension.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: There is no mention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR) in the transaction terms.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text does not specify the land area of the Renard project.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text does not specify the unit for the land area of the Renard project.

resource_size.justification: The text does not provide a mineral resource estimate for the Renard project. It mentions a Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) for the Adina project, but not for Renard.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the text as "Winsome Resources (ASX: WR1)".
